The relative strength in tech-heavy indices points to continued risk appetite among traders. No specific news catalysts were available in today's feed, so the move appears driven by ongoing sector momentum rather than a single headline event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市上揚，納斯達克指數升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映投資者對科技及增長股的偏好持續升溫。科技股相對強勢顯示市場風險胃納仍佳。由於今日未有具體新聞頭條可供引用，此升勢似乎是由板塊動能延續所帶動，而非單一消息刺激。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confirmation means waiting for multiple technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — to all point the same direction before making a trade. Relying on just one signal can lead to false starts, but when several agree, it suggests stronger, more reliable momentum.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號確認是指在交易前，等待多個技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、移動平均線及成交量）同時指向同一方向。只依賴單一訊號容易出現假突破，但當多個指標同時確認時，動能通常更為強勁及可靠。
